feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: California voters defeat billionaire tax proposal that divided Democrats
entry.summary: The novel proposal would have charged billionaires a one-time 5% tax on most of their overall wealth, including their ownership in companies.

entry.title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
entry.summary: France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.

entry.title: Stephen Miller is now chief of staff. What does that mean for Trump?
entry.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Chris Whipple, an expert on White House chiefs of staff who has written extensively about Susie Wiles, about Trump's appointment of Stephen Miller.

entry.title: Thomas Massie files articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
entry.summary: The articles accuse Hegseth of "high crimes and misdemeanors," including for waging war against Iran in violation of the War Powers Resolution.

entry.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
entry.summary: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.

entry.title: Congress is back after GOP's midterm defeat. And, Trump appoints new chief of staff
entry.summary: Republicans have just weeks left of control of Congress. Here's what to expect. And, Trump has appointed Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff, signaling his readiness to confront his opposition.

entry.title: After midterm losses, Trump makes changes to his inner circle
entry.summary: President Trump is shaking up his closest advisers after Democrats made huge gains in the midterm elections.

entry.title: Supreme Court weighs effort to shield federal law enforcement as ICE complaints rise
entry.summary: The Supreme Court considers the case of a prisoner who suffered brutal injuries, only to be denied medical care behind bars. He wants to sue the prison nurse in a case that could change the law on holding federal officers accountable.

entry.title: Democrats won big. Can they lower your grocery bill?
entry.summary: Affordability concerns were top of mind for voters heading into the midterms, as tariffs and the war in Iran drove up prices, including food costs. Now, Americans are expecting relief from Washington.

entry.title: Palantir hires a former Democratic senator as it faces scrutiny in new Congress
entry.summary: The secretive software company has been accused of letting its powerful tools be used by the Trump administration to surveil Americans. Now it's hiring former Sen. Jon Tester to burnish its image.
